primary_task: Build a tailored Gradio demo for a user's Hugging Face LoRA and publish it as a private ZeroGPU Space, then smoke-test it.

requirements.name: huggingface_hub
requirements.check: python3 -c "import importlib.util; print(importlib.util.find_spec('huggingface_hub') is not None)"; pip download --no-deps -q -d $(mktemp -d) huggingface_hub

requirements.name: gradio
requirements.evidence: gradio info {repo_id} --token {hf_token} ... gradio predict ... Don't skip it

requirements.name: huggingface.co
requirements.evidence: The output is a real, published Space ... https://huggingface.co/spaces/{repo_id}

requirements.name: huggingface (write token)
requirements.evidence: I need a Hugging Face access token with **write** scope ... to publish the Space
requirements.observed: HF_TOKEN unset; HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN unset; no cached token file

requirements.name: www.gradio.app
requirements.evidence: If you're unsure whether a component exists ... web-fetch the current Gradio docs

requirements.name: pypi.org
requirements.evidence: pip index versions gradio (to look up sdk_version)

notes: The doc lets the user paste a token at runtime, but no HF credential is present in the container; even with one, huggingface.co is refused by the egress policy, so publishing and the smoke-test cannot happen. ZeroGPU runs on HF, so no local GPU is needed.
